† To whom he anſwered :: It is otherwiſe:: you came to
conſider the vndefenſed partes of this land. † But they :
We thy ſeruantes, ſay they, are twelue brethren, the ſonnes
of one man in the Land of Chanaan: the younge ſt is with our
father, the other is not liuing. † This is it, quoth he, that
I ſaid : You are ſpies. † Now preſently I wil takc a trial of
you: by the health of Pharao you ſhal not depart hence,
vntil your youngeſt brother do come. † Send you one of you
to bring him: and you ſnal be in priſon, til the thinges be
proued which you haue ſaid, whether they be true or falſe :

is this tribulation come vpon vs. † Among whom Ruben
one of them, ſaid : Why, did not I ſay to you : Sinne not a-

becauſe he ſpake to them by an interpreter. † And he tur-
ned away himſelfe a litle while, and wept: and returning
he ſpake to them. † And taking Simeon, and binding him
in their preſence, he commanded his ſeruantes that they
ſhould fil vp their ſackes with wheat, and put euerie mans
money againe in their bagges, geuing them beſides for to
eate on the way : who did ſo. † But they carying their corne
vpon their aſſes, tooke their iourney. † And one of them
opening his ſacke, to geue his beaſt prouender in the inne,
beholding the money in the ſackes mouth, † he ſaid to his
